stem: Which inference about all freshmen at this college is best supported by this information?

options.label: F
options.text: The number of freshmen who chose English as their major is less than the number of freshmen who are Undecided on their major.

options.label: G
options.text: The number of freshmen who chose Education as their major is greater than the number of freshmen who chose Science or Other as their major.

options.label: H
options.text: The number of freshmen who chose Business or Education as their major is less than the number of freshmen who chose Science or Engineering as their major.

options.label: J
options.text: The number of freshmen who chose Business as their major is greater than the number of freshmen who chose English as their major.

visual_elements: Table with columns Major and Number of Freshmen, with data: English 50, Science 35, Engineering 40, Business 45, Education 60, Undecided 50, Other 20.
